messages:
maya: Heads up — traffic anomaly in us-west since 10:20 UTC. 5xxs up on model-route A when X-Client-Stage header present. Thinking emergency toggle to conditional fallback for that header pattern to reduce latency/queueing.
sam: can you paste the quick failure pattern and numbers? i want to see hit rate before we flip anything
maya: current: 8m window, 2.8% of requests with X-Client-Stage: beta have p95 latency > 1.8s and queue depth spikes on gpu-pool-3
maya: not global, concentrated on a subset of customer prefixes (prefix-4*, prefix-9*)
ryan: ok. proposal: apply conditional fallback rule: if header matches and origin prefix in set, route to model-B (lighter quantized) with streaming disabled. reduce concurrency to avoid noisy neighbor.
janet: agree on route to model-B as temporary. two asks before flip: 1) console toggle must show estimated QPS affected + quick rollback button, 2) require 1 ack from oncall + 1 from platform
maya: +1. also add a telemetry tag so we can filter traces and flamegraphs for that flow
sam: put the toggle behind a short-lived feature flag and rate-limit ramp (start 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 5m steps). prefer canary by header then weight, not a hard flip.
ryan: implemented a draft policy, pasting snippet:

```
- name: conditional-fallback-beta-header
  match:
    headers:
      X-Client-Stage: "beta"
    prefix_in: ["prefix-4", "prefix-9"]
  actions:
    fallback: model-b-quantized-v1
    streaming: false
    concurrency_limit: 8
    telemetry_tags: ["emergency:beta-header-2165439876"]
  rollout: {initial_weight: 0.1, steps: [0.5, 1.0], step_interval_secs: 300}
```

ryan: also plan to attach a config metadata field `owner_contact: @maya` and `rollback_playbook: /playbooks/ingress-fallback` for the console UI
janet: nice. make sure the console shows estimated token cost delta and a per-minute diff in 5xxs/latency after each step
ingress-bot: deploy-check: policy syntax valid. dry-run simulation: expected impacted qps 42 (0.3% overall). no dependency conflicts detected.
maya: scheduling flip now if everyone OK. i'll do the 10% step and watch for 5m window, then iterate. will call if anything odd. tagging @oncall in case it spikes
sam: do it. capture traces with `emergency:beta-header-2165439876` and enable slowtrace sampling for 1% of those requests
janet: confirm backup rollback: immediate revert if p95 increases or 5xx rate > baseline + 0.5% absolute for two consecutive 1m windows. runbook step: revert via console toggle -> confirm, run `ingressctl rollback --policy conditional-fallback-beta-header`
ryan: add metric panels to the temporary dashboard: p95, 5xx rate, queue depth on gpu-pool-3, fallback hitrate, token-rate. link: https://dashboards.internal/r/ingress/2165439876
maya: 10% rollout started at 2165439885
ingress-bot: telemetry-note: created dataset emergency_beta_header_2165439876. sampling=1% slowtraces enabled.
sam: observed initial 5m: no regressions, p95 down slightly for affected prefixes but overall cost up ~2% for those requests (expected)
maya: proceeding to 50% now (2165439930)
janet: monitor console alerts; if alert fires auto-pause and notify #eng-oncall + #platform
ingress-bot: alert-rule attached: emergency_beta_header_2165439876_alert. threshold: p95 > 2.5s OR 5xx_rate > baseline+0.5% sustained 1m
sam: 50% holds. queue depth stable. continuing to 100% in 5m unless any of you see red
ryan: preparing rollback command in case: `ingressctl set-policy-weight conditional-fallback-beta-header 0 && ingressctl delete-policy conditional-fallback-beta-header --confirm`
maya: moving to 100% (2165439990)
ingress-bot: rollout complete -> weight 1.0. affected qps ~125. created audit log id: audit-2165439876-01
sam: good job. after-action: we should add a console UX hint: when creating conditional fallbacks show simulated cost delta and a one-click create-rollback-button.
janet: opening a tiny ticket for Console UX: CTA + simulation panel + require two-step ack for emergency toggles. tagging @product-platform
maya: thanks team. leaving this thread open for postmortem notes and to attach the playbook outcome.
